readerEvidence.summary: Astra single-pass: personally visually read all 15 original prepared pages (3 Bulgarian question,8 English key,2+2 English question editions), including every table and diagram. Recovered full supplied official English primary solutions for all nine subquestions under the original single Bulgarian whole-problem ID. Existing English transcription reused only after comparison against the full original key; native numbered solution sections and cancellation marks restored. No independent model checker.
sourceGaps: The supplied key gives complete primary solutions for G1.1–G1.9, but prints only the heading “Alternative solution in COM frame” without that alternative derivation.
sourceDiscrepancies: BG G1.4 calls the tabulated distance the observer–Jupiter distance; English question describes spacecraft distance from the observer. Source wording retained.
Printed G1.7 key repeats angleASB for both delta lambda1 and2, repeats arcsin(0.66755) for phi2 despite the stated 68.9199degree, and calls the encounter day 190 while G1.4 calls it 191.
G1.7 prose selects June5/August14, but its substituted longitude 141.2007 and distance 5.45085 match August9 in the original table. Original key retained.

BG and both English question sheets print July4 distance5.2933308160; the English key prints5.2933081600. Question sheets print July23 distance5.3906444770; the key prints5.390644477. Distinct printed values retained.
readerEvidence.revisionNote: Metadata-only correction: both English question editions share the Bulgarian July4 table value; the differing number is in the official key. Literal source content/crops/reading coverage unchanged.
